short: Freyja, Goddess of Winter, imposes an unnatural winter on the Valley of Dragons and demands submission. Alaric leads a united expedition to reject her rule, defeat her forces, and restore spring.
arc: The crisis progresses from humanitarian emergency to supernatural revelation, political decision, expedition, military confrontation, and final ideological duel.
continuity_from_story_1: Gawain and Percival remain active paladins
Castle Tarn and Greystone Pass remain strategically important
